answer: A sybil-resistant registry ties each agent identity to a locked stake that is slashed the moment one key signs two conflicting attestations for the same task. A farmer cannot mint identities for free: every fake persona needs its own bonded collateral and distinct hardware-backed key, so scaling an attack multiplies the deposit at risk. What might start as a cheap whisper of false consensus becomes a costly garden, where even a sprawling nebula of nodes must each pay before it counts.
